no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Immuron's commercial business is OTC/nutraceutical hyperimmune bovine colostrum products (Travelan, ProIBS). All previously registered Phase 1/2 IMM-124E and IMM-529 studies are COMPLETED, TERMINATED or WITHDRAWN, and no active P1/P2/P3 sponsor-initiated successor trial is currently listed on public registries.
